findings.issue: Any non-404 API response throws and no route or middleware catches it, so every page becomes an unhandled 500 on a transient API failure.
findings.suggestion: Add a try/catch in the pages or an Astro middleware that renders the Not found/error layout when the API is unreachable.

findings.issue: The largest page builds its whole state as `page: any` with `(a: any)` callbacks, and api() returns any by default (app/src/lib/api.ts:52).
findings.suggestion: Define API response types in lib and type the assembled page object; add an `astro check` script to package.json.

findings.issue: withSlot resolves a queued waiter but increments active in a later microtask, so new callers can jump the queue and briefly exceed MAX_CONCURRENT.
findings.suggestion: Increment active before enqueuing resolution, or hand off the slot synchronously in the finally block.

findings.issue: Client scripts re-fetch full pages and swap fragments via data-results/data-move-tables selectors duplicated between template and script (also app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:232-233); the server/client contract is implicit, and fetches aren't aborted on superseded requests.
findings.suggestion: Centralize the selector names in one shared module and abort superseded fetches with AbortController.

findings.issue: security.checkOrigin is disabled although the app only uses GET forms; this weakens CSRF protection for no benefit.
The results fragment swap has no aria-live region, so screen-reader users get no announcement when filters change.
findings.suggestion: Add aria-live="polite" to the [data-results] container or announce the new count.

findings.issue: spriteUrl hard-codes the media URL pattern instead of using the sprite URLs in API data, coupling the app to the media server's layout.
findings.suggestion: Use the API-provided front_default sprite URL with the pattern as fallback.

findings.issue: No check/lint/test scripts despite a TypeScript-first setup; tsconfig references .astro/types.d.ts but nothing runs astro sync.
findings.suggestion: Add `astro sync` and `astro check` scripts and wire them into CI.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic, current-version Astro SSR app: clean routes, awaited frontmatter loading, bounded SWR caching, careful 404 handling and escaped markup throughout. The main merge blockers are the total absence of API error handling (any API hiccup becomes a raw 500) and any-typed data plumbing on the heaviest page. One round of changes, then approve.
